description: Locks in the exact PLAYER_LEFT/colorNumber-preservation property ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW.md's C7 flagged as drifted: a departed PLAYER is demoted to SPECTATOR (never deleted), and re-promoting them later restores their original colorNumber and join-order turn slot rather than handing them a new one. Server: _apply_roster_event + _finalize_roster (app.py), replayed by tests/test_roster_fold.py. Client: RosterReducer, replayed by RosterReducerTest#fixtureRoundTripMatchesServer, which folds these events via apply() and then calls syncFromRoster(expectedRoster) -- mirroring RunePartyPlugin's real live flow, since apply() alone never reconstructs 'number'/'colorNumber' from the event stream (see that test's own doc for why). Kept in sync by hand across the two separate repos -- there's no shared build between them (see check_event_parity.py's own doc for the same constraint on the event-type parity check).
